title: Stationary profiles of strict Newton trees
status: Draft; exact support, primitive lattice, strict optimizer and absolute boundary profiles for arbitrary fixed strict ordered expressions
imports: Physical turn, trace, complete pure leaf and Newton multiplication from Newton coefficients and positive sources for Conway tangles, Proposition 3.2, Theorem 3.3, Proposition 4.1 and equation (4.3); the uniform factorial estimate supplies the elementary positive-sum limit.

The reduced-junction criterion, boundary exclusion, uniqueness, negative Hessian and harmonic boundary response are proved here. This paper imports neither a whole signed-source bound nor a hyperbolic metric theorem.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
